FAQ

Clear answers
before you start.

Built to answer the questions an international customer is likely to ask before contacting you.

Do you work with businesses in the United States?

Yes. PixelBuilt is positioned for remote projects worldwide, including US businesses.

How much does a website cost?

Essential is USD 599 and Signature is USD 1,399. Custom requirements can be quoted separately.

Do I need to pay before seeing the website?

We first agree the project scope and quotation. The design is then prepared for review. Payment is completed after final preview approval and before launch and handover.

What payment methods are available?

International payment options can include Wise / bank transfer, PayPal and card payment. The confirmed method will be stated on the quotation.

Can you design for my industry if it is not shown here?

Yes. PixelBuilt is not limited to the industries shown. The design direction is adapted to the business.

What if I am not sure which package suits me?

Choose “Not sure yet” in the smart enquiry form and we can recommend the better fit based on your services, pages and customer journey.
